g.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

text.tspan: roomscope demo
RoomScope demo
SYNTHETIC DATA: a simulated room. No audio hardware is used and nothing is
played; the numbers below describe the simulation, not a real room.
1. Test signal
roomscope-demo/sweep.wav (48000 Hz, 20-20000 Hz, 5 s sweep)
2. Simulated recordings (what your DAW would export)
roomscope-demo/position-a.wav position A: close to the desk and the side wall
roomscope-demo/position-b.wav position B: moved 1 m back from the desk
3. Analysis (vocal profile)
Position A: close to the desk and the side wall
Reverberation RT60 0.70 s (broadband, from T30)
Early reflections strongest at 2.4 ms: -3.1 dB re direct (2 above -20 dB)
Low end potential resonances: 110 Hz (+11.3 dB)
Noise floor -69.2 dBFS RMS (uncalibrated)
, mains hum at 50 Hz
Data quality direct-sound confidence high, core warnings: 0
[notice]
early_reflections: A strong early reflection is present
approximately 2 ms after the direct sound (-3.1 dB). Close-miked vocals
are coloured by reflections this early; move the microphone closer to
the singer and farther from the nearest hard surface, or treat that
surface, then measure again.
[notice]
reverberation: The broadband decay is noticeable
(estimated RT60 0.70 s from T30). A vocal that is this live picks up
room colour between phrases; add absorption or move to a drier position.
(+3 more in the full report: roomscope show roomscope-demo/position-a)
Position B: moved 1 m back from the desk
Reverberation RT60 0.51 s (broadband, from T30)
Early reflections strongest at 9.3 ms: -14.5 dB re direct (1 above -20 dB)
Low end potential resonances: 110 Hz (+10.7 dB)
Noise floor -87.1 dBFS RMS (uncalibrated)
, mains hum at 50 Hz
Data quality direct-sound confidence high, core warnings: 0
[notice]
reverberation: The broadband decay is noticeable
(estimated RT60 0.51 s from T30). A vocal that is this live picks up
room colour between phrases; add absorption or move to a drier position.
[notice]
reverberation: Low frequencies decay more slowly than the
mid range (0.82 s vs 0.45 s), which makes vocals sound boxy at this
position. Bass trapping or a different position helps.
(+2 more in the full report: roomscope show roomscope-demo/position-b)
4. Comparison A -> B
Reverberation RT60 0.70 s -> 0.51 s (-27.3 %)
Early reflections 2 gone, 1 new, 0 at both
Low end at both: 110 Hz
Noise floor -69.2 -> -87.1 dBFS (-17.9 dB)
Frequency response largest change in the 31.5 Hz octave (7.8 dB mean |Δ|)
[notice]
reverberation: Broadband estimated RT60 went from 0.70 s
to 0.51 s (-27.3 % of the baseline, shorter). ISO 3382-1 quotes a just-
noticeable difference for T of about 5 %; a single pair of positions is
not enough to call the change significant.
[info]
noise: Background noise went from -69.2 dBFS to -87.1 dBFS
(-17.9 dB) at the declared-equal input gain.
Next steps
roomscope show roomscope-demo/position-a
full report for position A
roomscope compare roomscope-demo/position-a roomscope-demo/position-b --same-input-gain
full comparison
roomscope gui
open the sessions in the desktop app (needs the 'gui' extra)
roomscope sweep --out sweep.wav
start a real measurement with your DAW
